newsitem.title: UK: UK parents in red alert Buzz Goodyear search.
newsitem.headline: UK parents in red alert Buzz Goodyear search.

text.p: British parents desperately searching for the hero of the Disney hit film "Toy Story" in toy shops around the country cannot find the bleeping plastic robot in time for Christmas.
"We are taking 200 calls a day for them and people are even calling from the United States," said a spokesman at "top people's shop" Harrods.
The film, a summer hit at cinemas, was released on video last month, provoking a surge of requests to Santa Claus from thousands of British children.

The Sunday Telegraph newspaper sent reporters around Britain to hunt in vain for Buzz. Their solution -- fly out to southern China and get one of the models being manufactured round the clock at factories there in a desperate bid to meet demand.
